title: Lenox Homespun 12-Piece Dinnerware Set, White (Service for 4)

comparisons.notes: Same Lenox Homespun 12-piece stoneware set, service for 4 (4 dinner plates, 4 salad plates, 4 bowls); in stock with free shipping.

writeup: Lenox's Homespun stoneware set in white is $89.99 new at Woot, a service for four with four dinner plates, four salad plates and four bowls. Zola charges $159.99 for the same 12-piece set, and Lenox's own site is sold out. Woot shows only a few left with a limit of 3 per customer.
